title: Common Table Expressions (CTEs)
description: Use CTEs for readability and recursive queries.

data.text: CTEs use WITH to define temporary result sets. Recursive CTEs handle hierarchical data.

data.title: Recursive CTE
data.code:
WITH RECURSIVE reports AS (
  SELECT id, name, manager_id, 1 AS depth
  FROM employees
  WHERE manager_id IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.id, e.name, e.manager_id, r.depth + 1
  FROM employees e
  JOIN reports r ON r.id = e.manager_id
)
SELECT * FROM reports ORDER BY depth, name;

data.title: Recursive
data.text: Use UNION ALL to avoid repeated distinct sorting in recursive CTEs.
